svg.title: Nerve cell
svg.desc: Neuron with soma, nucleus and nucleolus, branching dendrites, axon hillock, myelinated axon segments, and terminal arbor. Biological basis: Neurons receive input through dendrites and conduct action potentials along axons; myelin is interrupted at nodes of Ranvier.
